pr_title: Allow D-Bus methods to auth. for more than one polkit action
pr_body:
The current code handling async. polkit authentication allows a D-Bus method to auth. for at most one action. If the same method tries to auth. for another action, it'll end with `-ESTALE`. That's a problem for `verify_shutdown_creds()`, which may need to authenticate for both `org.freedesktop.login1.hibernate-multiple-sessions` and `org.freedesktop.login1.hibernate-ignore-inhibit`. This PR extends the handling of async. polkit requests to allow auth. for multiple actions. Unfortunately, it increases complexity of already quite complex code (esp. wrt. memory management)...

Fixes #20155

issue_context.title: logind fails at authenticating with -ESTALE when processing a request for hibernating and an inhibitor lock is taken by another user
issue_context.body:
Steps to reproduce:

Root is logged via ssh and takes a lock with:
```root@localhost # systemd-inhibit --who=root-locker --why=test --mode=block --what=sleep sleep infinity```

On a tty, a regular user is logged and can check that the lock is taken:

```
fbui@locahost # systemd-inhibit --list
WHO          UID USER PID  COMM            WHAT  WHY                           
root-locker  0   root 1558 systemd-inhibit sleep test
```
He then attempts to hibernate with the check for inhibitors disabled:

```
fbui@localhost # systemctl hibernate --check-inhibitors=no
==== AUTHENTICATING FOR org.freedesktop.login1.hibernate-multiple-sessions ====
Authentication is required to hibernate the system while other users are logged in.
Authenticating as: root
Password: 
==== AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE ====
Failed to hibernate system via logind: Stale file handle
==== AUTHENTICATING FOR org.freedesktop.systemd1.manage-units ====
Authentication is required to start 'hibernate.target'.
Authenticating as: root
Password:
```

As this can be seen, several authentications were requested:

- one by logind for `org.freedesktop.login1.hibernate-multiple-sessions` which was successful 
- one by logind for `org.freedesktop.login1.hibernate-ignore-inhibit`  which failed with "Stale file handle"
- one by systemctl for `org.freedesktop.systemd1.manage-units` : systemctl felt back to starting `hibernate.target` directly because logind failed

For some reasons the second auth request failed with -ESTALE which is not expected.
